48.original: Ye know, <hex:020813E905FF076C6173736965FF076C616464696503>, if yer just gonna stand around with yer thumb up yer arse, I can give ye somethin' to do.

49.original: Thanks to me unbelievably low prices, we've no shortage of customers here at the Coffer & Coffin. But by the same token, I can't afford to hire much help. We're chronically understaffed.

50.original: What's more, there's those lazy-arsed types what refuse to come an' order at the counter. It'd be a great help if ye could attend these customers for me.

51.original: Mark their orders on these here slips, then bring them here. Oh, and don't forget about ol' Adalfuns outside.

52.original: Thal's balls, I'm spent! Grilled dodo, and a tankard of ale to wash it down!

53.original: Gah, here I am again, spendin' what meager coin I've got at the Coffin... It ain't me fault, I tell ye! Ye'd do the same if yer wife served up shite every bleedin' day!

54.original: Roger's new errand <hex:02080EE905FF056769726CFF04626F7903>, are you? Well then, I'll keep it simple for your sake: a tankard of your finest ale, chilled with an ice shard.

55.original: Heh heh... There's nothing like a tall drink to help one forget about the trifling things in life─like work.

56.original: The strongest brandewine you've got. I need help to forget...

57.original: Gods, I'm starving! Bring me ale, grilled dodo, and smoked shrew loaf! And make it quick!

58.original: Business is good─too good, even. I've nary got the time to take a piss, let alone eat. The mere thought of the Coffin's cooking makes my mouth water!

60.original: Let's see here... Ale, brandewine, grilled dodo...

61.original: And for Adalfuns... Lemme guess─one tankard of ale. Right bleedin' miser, that one. I oughta put me boot up his arse.

62.original: Anyroad, ye did good, <hex:020813E905FF076C6173736965FF076C616464696503>. By way of thanks, I'm gonna tell ye somethin' what ought to prove to yer profit.
